_readme: Files for the /nicole thread. Drop a file in this folder and push and it
appears in that thread's rail -- and ONLY that thread's.
This folder is committed to a PUBLIC repository, so anything here is
downloadable from GitHub even though netlify.toml 404s the path on the
live site. For anything actually private, use the upload button in the
page instead: that encrypts into Netlify Blobs and never touches git.
Entries under "files" are optional; a file with no entry still shows up
